summary: Acquired by **Shift4** for $250M cash; deal completed Jun 2024; Revel had 18,000+ restaurant locations
Absorbed into Shift4 (see round-one Shift4 entry). Isaacman said Shift4 doesn't need "two restaurant products" and would fold the best of Revel into SkyTab (now Shift4 Dine)
Revel had "intentionally overlooked payments" (Isaacman), so Shift4 is pushing its own processing onto the base — possible churn among Revel merchants who don't want forced payments

Shift4 completed its acquisition of Revel in June 2024 and stated the deal brought approximately 18,000 merchant locations and a potential $17B in payments volume. (Scope note: Acquisition-era merchant count is stale and payment opportunity is a projection, not realized volume.)
